helpers.complete_header:
theorem section16_poly_piece_two_decomposition_of_extract
    {N : Nat} [NeZero N] {theta mass cap zeta : Real} {qs qr ql : Nat}
    (hmass : 0 < mass) (Gamma : Finset (Point N 2 × ZMod N))
    (hsize : (Gamma.card : Real) ≤ cap * (N : Real) ^ 2)
    (hextract : ∀ Delta ⊆ Gamma,
      theta * (N : Real) ^ 2 ≤ (relationProjection Delta).card →
      Nonempty (PolyPieceTwoData Delta zeta mass qs qr ql)) :
    ∃ J : Finset (Point N 2), (1 - theta) * (N : Real) ^ 2 ≤ J.card ∧
      ∃ P : Fin ⌊cap / mass⌋₊ →
        PolyPieceTwoData (Finset.univ : Finset (Point N 2 × ZMod N)) zeta 0 qs qr ql,
        restrictRelation Gamma J ⊆ Finset.univ.biUnion fun c => partialGraph (P c).D (P c).phi

mathematical_review.greedy_extraction: The supplied callback works for every subrelation Delta of Gamma with the stated projection bound. P.graph_sub gives a graph contained in Delta and partialGraph_card plus P.card_ge gives mass*N² points. Widening P to Finset.univ preserves D,phi and every structural field while discharging ambient containment. Therefore the existing greedy theorem yields q,J and coverage with q*(mass*N²)<=card Gamma.
mathematical_review.floor_and_boundaries: NeZero N implies N²>0. Chaining the greedy estimate with hsize and reassociating products gives (q*mass)*N²<=cap*N². Cancellation and division by mass>0 yield q<=cap/mass, hence q<=Nat.floor(cap/mass) with no ceiling or +1 loss. No cap>0 assumption is needed: card Gamma>=0 and N²>0 force cap>=0 whenever hsize is inhabited. theta and zeta need no additional restriction in this abstract callback theorem.
mathematical_review.padding: For j<q use the selected original graph after toMassZero; for j>=q use the existing empty piece. Any i:Fin q maps to Fin floor(cap/mass) using i.isLt.trans_le hqm. Record updates preserve D and phi, and proof irrelevance handles the dependent Fin witness. Finset.mem_biUnion proves coverage. If q=0 or the floor bound is0, the indexing construction remains valid and the greedy coverage is empty where required.
mathematical_review.universal_ambient: The old large-cover route used pieces in Gamma; the shared helper widens to universal ambient. section16_poly_family_two_cover has an arbitrary ambient Gamma with no cardinality or product condition, so it applies equally to universal pieces. Its result is restricted back to restrictRelation Gamma J using hcov; no stronger ambient assumption is introduced.
mathematical_review.four_specializations: All four original hypotheses remain. cap=gamma^(-2) and mass=5*polyPieceBudget (or5*polyPieceBudgetW(fejerThetaOne)) make floor(cap/mass) exactly polyTwoPieces/polyTwoFejerPieces. Universal PolyPieceTwoData with mass0 is exactly PolyPieceTwo/PolyPieceTwoFejer, and the biUnion target is exactly the corresponding graph-union definition. hN,hprod and prime hypotheses remain in the extraction callback.
mathematical_review.mass_and_context: The printed and Fejer mass positivity obligations follow from retained section16ThetaTwo positivity facts and budget=/8. In the Fejer cover, the remaining tightZeta bound uses retained hfaS<=1/36; the deleted budget positivity alias is unnecessary to prove <=1. Old classical commands move into the generic construction that actually uses choice; specialized proofs only invoke the helper.
native_elaboration_notes_at_frozen_revie: The helper relies on reducibility of section16FinsetUnion when applying Finset.mem_biUnion.mp; mathematically it is exactly Finset.univ.biUnion.
Dependent Fin padding uses definitionally equal indices/proof irrelevance and record projections through toMassZero; native elaboration remains untested.
